OUTPUT.description: Folder of the suite, report.json and litellm-config.yaml when --suite or --out is not given.

TASKCAPTURE_FORGE_URL.description: Base URL of the forge API for capture. Default: https://api.github.com for github.com, <origin>/api/v3 for another GitHub host, <origin>/api/v1 for Forgejo.

TASKCAPTURE_FORGE_TOKEN.description: Token that may read the repository, for capture: sent to the forge API and to git clone. Without it, capture reads a public repository. Never written into a task.
